read.thesis: ASML raised FY26 sales to €43–45bn and plans 30% more Low-NA EUV and immersion capacity in 2027 (about 85 and 110 tools), with 2028 investigated at another 30%, supply-side expansion driven by AI logic and DRAM demand.

capex.quote: we are planning to increase our Low-NA EUV capacity by around 30%

triggers.label: 2027 Low-NA capacity +30%
triggers.quote: we are planning to increase our Low-NA EUV capacity by around 30%

triggers.label: FY26 sales raised to €43–45bn
triggers.quote: We now expect total net sales between EUR 43 billion and EUR 45 billion

triggers.label: Value-based pricing flexibility rising
triggers.quote: the current environment provides more flexibility for pricing than what you would have had in different days

triggers.label: Memory sales growth >75% in 2026
triggers.quote: we anticipate our memory-related net system sales to grow by over 75% this year

triggers.label: 2028 capacity +30% under investigation
triggers.quote: Strong demand forecasts from our customers have led us to investigate a further 30% capacity increase for that year

guidance.quote: We now expect total net sales between EUR 43 billion and EUR 45 billion
with a gross margin between 54% and 56%
We expect Q3 total net sales to be between EUR 11 billion and EUR 12 billion
Gross margin for Q3 is expected to be between 55% and 57%.
We now expect to ship around 65 Low-NA EUV systems this year
we expect about 130 shipments this year
Installed Base Management sales are expected to grow over 30% this year
we continue to expect this to make up around 20% of our total net sales for the full year
we intend to increase capacity by 30% in 2027
investigate a further 30% capacity increase for that year
